card.name: Book blurbs naming the intended readers
card.fires_on: Words in a phrase that names the target audience, such as 'for all those', 'those interested', 'experts involved' or 'researchers in', mostly in book descriptions and reviews. It fires right before the field or activity that the audience works in.

modes.label: Audience phrase
modes.description: Words like for, all, those, interested, engaged or involved that lead into the field the readers work in.
modes.example: This volume is an invaluable reference for<< all>> those engaged in the areas of genetics,

modes.label: Condition wording in drug text
modes.description: Nouns like conditions or states that come before a clause on use or treatment.
modes.example: Naproxen sodium tablets are recommended for the management of acute painful<< conditions>> when prompt onset of pain relief is desired

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that complete a phrase about a field or topic, such as 'preference' or 'demand', but the output effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in phrases saying who a book is for, just before the field or interest is named.
